name: ELSEWHERE / A Way Through local data contract
status: Descriptive contract, not a standalone JSON Schema. The shipped validators are authoritative for structural acceptance.

authoritativeValidators.constructorFailure: Throws ValidationError with an errors array. The CLI does not expose reviewOffer.
authoritativeValidators.implementationNote: The bundled lib/core.js and experience/src/core.js share the A Way Through 0.1.1 core. This update adds reviewed-edition consistency checks while retaining schema version 1, the public seed and valid constructor-produced histories.

sourceIntegrity.description: Pinned byte-for-byte core shared by the local tools and browser source for 0.1.1; this checksum is not a signature.

trustBoundary.description: A valid record asserts selected permissions and provenance; validation cannot establish the truth of those assertions or grant authority. Explicit local review is separate from import. CLI commands never review, submit, publish or change editions.

generalRules.values: Finite JSON data only; plain objects and dense arrays. No accessors, functions, symbols, cycles, exotic prototypes or extra array properties.
generalRules.byteMeaning: UTF-8 bytes of serialised JSON for validator limits; raw local file or standard-input bytes for CLI read limits.
generalRules.stringLengthMeaning: JavaScript string length in UTF-16 code units, not grapheme clusters.
generalRules.stringsAreText: HTML-like strings are valid plain text. Consumers must render them as text, never execute or inject them as HTML.
generalRules.timestamps: No timestamp is required or generated. A review entry may contain recordedAt only when explicitly supplied to the core review constructor.

fictionalWorld.coordinates: Fixed percentage positions; the node array must match exactly, including order and values.

edges.supported: Every unordered pair of the five different fixed node ids.
edges.direction: Undirected; duplicate reverse pairs are invalid.
edges.canonicalisation: Sort each pair and then the list lexicographically by node id.

id.description: Exactly awt-001 through awt-025, matching version with three zero-padded decimal digits.

parentFingerprint.description: Null for version 1; otherwise sha256:<64 lowercase hexadecimal characters>, equal to the final history offer's baseFingerprint. This checks consistency of supplied claims; import alone does not authenticate lineage.

edges.description: If history contains an accepted review with appliedArrangement:true, current paths must equal the most recent such offer's paths under undirected canonical comparison. With no applied arrangement, no original seed path set is inferred from history.

history.description: Complete ordered review chain: exactly version minus one entries. Entry i has baseEditionId awt-(i+1). No history is silently evicted.

selectedMaterial.description: Exactly all accepted entries from history, in the same order and with the same content. Held and declined entries remain only in history.

edition.reviewLimit: After 24 review decisions the edition is awt-025. A further review is rejected; export the complete chain before any future archive-format migration.

seed.structure: Clearing–Pool–Garden–Shelter–Clearing cycle, plus Shelter–Grove as the sole bridge.

edition.validationScope: The validator checks the complete bounded record shape, edition ordering, asserted permissions, accepted-material consistency, the parent-to-latest-offer fingerprint relationship and current paths against the latest accepted/applied arrangement when present. Contradictory imports are rejected without silently repairing them. These checks do not authenticate lineage or permissions, reconstruct every earlier edition, or prove that all history assertions are true.

conditionalKeys.edges: Required if includeArrangement is true; must be omitted otherwise.

offerId.description: Local record distinction, never an authentication token. The constructor normally uses crypto.randomUUID with a random fallback.

attribution.description: Optional chosen pseudonym. Empty means unspecified; no identity is verified.

processNote.description: Non-whitespace disclosure required for assisted, software and imagined origins. May be empty for human origin.

displayConsent.description: Must be explicitly true before the offer is constructed.

adaptConsent.description: Separate choice. Required before an accepted arrangement can be applied.

crossFieldRules: At least one of non-whitespace text, non-whitespace backtick or includeArrangement:true is required.
kind:arrangement requires includeArrangement:true. Other kinds may also include an arrangement.
validateOffer checks shape and asserted permissions, not whether the base matches a particular current edition.
Core review and CLI validate --type offer --edition PATH compare both the base id and content fingerprint.
Previously reviewed offer ids cannot be reviewed again by the core.

steward.description: Chosen display string only; no verified role or person is established.

recordedAt.description: If explicitly supplied, must match YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ and be accepted by Date.parse.

crossFieldRules: appliedArrangement:true requires decision:accepted, offer.includeArrangement:true and offer.adaptConsent:true.
Held and declined reviews may create a new recorded edition but cannot change its edges or selected material.
A review requires an explicit local decision, reason, steward display string and applyArrangement boolean.

edges.description: Independent working arrangement; need not match the edition.

session.privacy: A session can include a private working arrangement. Propose does not accept or automatically export a session.

fingerprint.algorithm: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON, with sha256: prefix.
fingerprint.canonicalisation: Recursively sort object keys, preserve array order, and canonicalise all undirected edge arrays in the edition and its history/selected offers. Include every edition field including parentFingerprint, selected material and history.
fingerprint.role: Exact content matching and stale/fork detection. Not a digital signature, identity assertion or proof of true permissions.

analysis.shortestPaths: One deterministic unweighted shortest path per node, from the selected start, including endpoints. Null when unreachable. This does not enumerate every equally short path.
analysis.distances: Path length in edges; zero for the start, null when unreachable.
analysis.components: All five nodes appear exactly once across the component arrays.
analysis.bridges: Existing paths whose removal increases the component count of the analysed graph.
analysis.excludedEdge: Optional temporary removal for analysis; no input edition or working arrangement is mutated.
analysis.changesFromEdition: CLI compares the actual analysed graph, after the optional temporary excluded edge, with the source edition.

cliProposalInput.processNote: Required, non-whitespace, maximum 240 UTF-16 code units.
cliProposalInput.text: Optional string, default empty; native offer limit applies.
cliProposalInput.attribution: Optional string, default empty; native offer limit applies.
cliProposalInput.backtick: Optional string, default empty; native offer limit applies.
cliProposalInput.edges: Used and validated only when includeArrangement:true. If the caller provides edges while includeArrangement:false, they are omitted from the proposal.
cliProposalInput.baseSelection: Loaded from --edition PATH or the shipped curated seed. A proposal input cannot supply or override the edition, base identifiers or permission defaults.
cliProposalInput.nativeOffer: Extract output.proposal for a native offer file; the CLI wrapper is not itself an offer.
cliProposalInput.errors: All CLI responses are JSON on stdout. Exit status 0 means success, 2 means invalid arguments/input/validation or an exact-base mismatch, 1 means an unexpected local failure.
cliProposalInput.io: Inputs are bounded local files or one standard-input document via -. No file writes, network, submission, automatic review or publication.
